verdict.rationale: Proa serves its complete documentation at /llms-full.txt for agent consumption, and content retrieved from that URL appears in the pack. Its docs routes also expose Markdown variants (e.g. /docs/agents.md), and it has a dedicated agents docs page plus scaffolded AGENTS.md project guidance. However, the probe found no llms.txt index (404), and /docs.md returned 404, which undercuts the claim that every docs route exposes Markdown. Missing for 10: a working /llms.txt index, a Markdown variant for the docs root (/docs.md), independent hands-on corroboration.
